SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal relationships is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal relationships.
   B. Treat Diversity and interpersonal relationships as rumours only.
   C. Say Diversity and interpersonal relationships never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Peaceful Coexistence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Peaceful Coexistence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Coexistence.
   C. Treat Peaceful Coexistence as rumours only.
   D. Explain Peaceful Coexistence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Self- Exploration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Exploration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Exploration.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

7. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.

   D. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.

9. Which statement about Maps and map work is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and map work.
   B. Say Maps and map work never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Maps and map work as rumours only.
   D. Explain Maps and map work with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.
   C. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Historical information as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Slavery and Servitude with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

13. Which statement about Early Civilisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Early Civilisation as rumours only.
   B. Say Early Civilisation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation.
   D. Explain Early Civilisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.

16. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Human Origin.
   C. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Human Origin never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Slavery and Servitude and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Developments in Medium of trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
